generation.raw_text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Tooth decay starts when the pH of the mouth is lower than 5.5. This is because tooth enamel, which is made of calcium phosphate, is the hardest substance in the body and does not dissolve in water. However, it can be corroded when the pH in the mouth drops below 5.5. Bacteria in the mouth produce acids by breaking down sugar and food particles, which lowers the pH and leads to tooth decay. To prevent this, it is important to clean the mouth after eating and use toothpaste, which is generally basic, to neutralize the excess acid.","selected_evidence_ids":["E1"],"citations":[{"evidence_id":"E1","pdf_page":60,"textbook_page":50}],"missing_information":[]}
